data.body: Clarification: '≥2 labelers per fixture' will be satisfied by ≥2 independent LLM agent runs (different temperature seeds, e.g., temperature=0.5 and temperature=0.7) per fixture. Each run produces labeler_id: llm_agent_run_N. provenance: llm_agent (distinct from heuristic). Cohen's kappa computed between runs. Corpus is a preliminary calibration baseline — not human-validated production ground truth. This unblocks the story without recruiting human labelers.
